title: AMD Q4 2023 Earnings Call
transcript:
Operator: Welcome to the AMD fourth quarter 2023 earnings conference call.

CEO: Data center revenue grew strongly driven by EPYC and Instinct GPU demand. Client segment remained mixed as PC recovery progressed gradually.

CFO: Gross margin was 47 percent. We expect first quarter revenue to be approximately flat sequentially with continued data center growth.

Question-and-Answer Session

Analyst: Can you quantify the data center growth rate and how much was driven by AI accelerators versus traditional server CPUs?

CEO: Data center revenue increased significantly year-over-year. AI accelerator revenue contributed to growth but EPYC remained the largest component.

Analyst: How should we think about gross margin trajectory given mix shift toward accelerators?

CFO: We expect margins to remain in a similar range near term with product mix as the primary driver.

Analyst: What is your view on PC TAM recovery and inventory in the channel?

CEO: We believe PC demand is stabilizing but recovery timing remains uneven across geographies.

title: AMD Q3 2023 Earnings Call
transcript:
Operator: Welcome to the AMD third quarter 2023 earnings call.

CEO: We delivered solid results with record data center revenue. Instinct MI300 series customer engagement expanded.

Question-and-Answer Session

Analyst: Can you update us on MI300 production ramp and customer adoption timelines?

CEO: We remain on track for volume production with hyperscaler and enterprise interest increasing.

Analyst: How competitive is your AI portfolio versus alternatives in inference and training?

CEO: We believe our open software stack and performance-per-dollar are differentiated.

Analyst: What are the main assumptions embedded in your guidance for the next quarter?

CFO: Guidance assumes stable macro conditions and continued growth in data center offsetting client seasonality.
